app.title: Mframapa AI
app.tagline: AI Tlhahlobo ya Moya ka Nako ya Nnete bakeng sa Afrika
hero.subheadline_prefix: Diponelopele tsa boleng ba moya ka AI bakeng sa
error.geolocation_unsupported: Geolocation ha e tshehetswi ke sebatli sa hao
error.location_retrieval: Ha ho khonehe ho fumana sebaka sa hao
error.outside_africa: Tshwarelo, Mframapa AI e akaretsa dinaha tsa Afrika feela.
error.city_not_found: Toropo ha e fumanehe kapa e ka ntle.
error.generic: Ha ho khonehe ho fumana toropo. Ka kopo leka hape.
error.land_mass: Sebaka ha se fumanehe. Ka kopo tobetsa mobu.
card.checking: Ho hlahloba boleng ba moya ho
card.share_text: Boleng ba moea ho {{city}}: {{pm25}} µg/m³ ({{category}}) ka Mframapa AI
aqi.sensitive: E Sa Phelong bakeng sa Dihlopha tse Nahanang
advice.good: Boleng ba moya bo botle. Thabela mesebetsi e kantle!
advice.moderate: Boleng bo mahareng. Batho ba nahanang ba tlameha ho fokotsa nako.
advice.sensitive: E sa phelong bakeng sa dihlopha tse nahanang. Apara sefahleho ha ho hlokahala.
advice.unhealthy: Boleng ba moya bo theohile. Fokotsa mesebetsi e kantle.
insight.good: Maemo a hloekileng a moea ka lebaka la ho hasana hantle ha moea. E bolokehile bakeng sa mesebetsi eohle.
insight.moderate: Ho bokellana ha likaroloana tse nyenyane. Maemo a amoheleha ho batho ba bangata.
insight.sensitive: Likaroloana tse phahameng tse ka bang teng ho tsoa mesing ea lehae. Lihlopha tse nang le kutloelo-bohloko li lokela ho nka mehato ea ho itšireletsa.
insight.unhealthy: Botsitso bo phahameng ba likaroloana bo hlokometsoe. E fana ka maikutlo a mehloli ea lintho tse tukang sebakeng seo.
insight.hazardous: Boleng ba moea bo kotsi. Lula ka tlung 'me u sebelise sefa moea ha ho khoneha.
about.title: Ka Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI e akanya PM2.5 letsatsi le leng le le leng dinaheng tse 54 tsa Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Ditoropo tse ngata tsa Afrika ha di na disebediswa tsa ho hlahloba moya. Re tlatsela sekgeo seo.
about.how.intro: Ho sebelisa data ea satellite le ho ithuta ha mochini.
about.how.step1.title: Di-Satellite e le Disensors
about.how.step1.desc: Ho sebelisa data ea ESA Sentinel-5P le NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Tlhophiso ea Mobu
about.how.step2.desc: Modeli e rupetsoe libakeng tse 398 tsa ho hlahloba dinaheng tse 29.
about.how.step3.title: Inference ea Kontinente
about.how.step3.desc: Modeli ea XGBoost e bonelopele PM2.5 bakeng sa sebaka sefe kapa sefe sa Afrika.
about.limit.intro: Ditekanyo tsa bohlokwa tse lokelang ho tsejoa.
about.limit.cloud_desc: Di-satellite ha di khone ho bona ka maru a matla.
about.limit.gap_desc: Ho fetisetsa ha satellite letsatsi le leng le le leng ho ka fetisisa dikgeo tse khutšoanyane tsa tšilafalo.
about.limit.legal_desc: Ditekanyo ha se ditekanyo tse amohelwang.
about.who.citizens_desc: Hlahloba boleng ba moya pele ho mesebetsi e kantle.
report.title: Tlaleho ea Moya
report.subtitle: Kenya letsoho ho data ea sechaba.
report.success_desc: Rea leboha ka ho kenya letsoho.
report.location_mock: Ho sebelisa sebaka se nahanwang ho tswa bohareng ba mmapa
report.placeholder_obs: mohlala: Monko oa mosi, mohodi o bonwang...
report.clue.good: Moea o matla. Ha ho mohodi o bonwang.
report.clue.moderate: Moea o loketse. Mohodi o monyenyane haholo.
report.clue.unhealthy: Mosi/smog e bonwang. Ho halefa ho hanyenyane.
report.clue.hazardous: Mosi/lerōle le boima. Ho bona ho hobe.
pwa.home.subtitle: Litlhahlobo tse potlakileng tsa boemo ba toropo PM2.5 tse nang le boiphihlelo ba sehlahisoa se sa tsebeng letho.
pwa.home.loading_message: E lata lintlha tsa morao-rao tsa motheo...
pwa.search.label: Batla
pwa.search.offline: Offline mode — e bonts'a lenane la litoropo tse bolokiloeng
pwa.core.map_token: Beha VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN ho nolofalletsa ho fana ka 'mapa.
pwa.core.no_city_pack: Ha ho na pakete ea toropo e bolokiloeng e fumanehang hajoale
pwa.core.location_error: Ha e khone ho fumana sebaka seo o leng ho sona — sheba letshwao la GPS ebe o leka hape
pwa.core.location_permission: Ho haneloa ho fihlella sebaka — ka kopo lumella sebaka ho litlhophiso tsa sebatli sa hau
pwa.core.africa_only: Sesebelisoa sena se akaretsa metse ea Afrika feela - tlanya ka hare ho Afrika
pwa.core.land_only: Tlanya fatše ho bala, eseng leoatleng
pwa.search.no_saved_title: Ha ho na metse e bolokehileng
pwa.search.no_saved_message: Batla 'me u tsamaise cheke ho eketsa litoropo tse fihlellehang kapele.
pwa.search.no_matches_message: Leka lebitso le leng la toropo kapa senotlolo sa naha.
pwa.core.start_body: Re tla khutlisa boemo ba PM2.5 le ho ntlafatsa kakaretso ea dashboard ea hau.
pwa.core.offline_message: Litšebelisano tsa 'mapa li na le moeli ha u ntse u le sieo inthaneteng. Hokela hape ho fumana 'malo o mocha oa teropo.
pwa.core.city_pack_title: Ho lokisa pakete ea toropo ntle le inthanete
pwa.core.city_pack_message: Ho hokahanya lethathamo la litoropo tse holimo bakeng sa ho batla le ho sebelisoa ntle le inthanete.
pwa.network.offline: Offline mode: e bonts'a data e bolokiloeng ha e fumaneha
pwa.network.online: Khutlela inthaneteng: e khathollang ka data ea morao-rao
pwa.settings.lite: Boemo bo bobebe (lintlha tse fokotsehileng tsa 'mapa)
pwa.onboarding.step1_body: Batla toropo efe kapa efe ea Afrika e tšehelitsoeng 'me u fumane boemo ba PM2.5 ka metsotsoana.
pwa.onboarding.step2_title: Lula u tseba, ntle le inthanete
pwa.onboarding.step2_body: Sesebelisoa se boloka licheke tsa hau tsa morao-rao bakeng sa maemo a tlase a khokahanyo.
pwa.onboarding.step3_body: U ka sebelisa khetho ea toropo ea matsoho le ho qoba ho latela sebaka sa kamehla.
pwa.auth.subtitle: Kena ho hokahanya tlhahlobo ea toropo ea hau le litlhokomeliso.
pwa.auth.offline_title: Marang-rang a hlokahala bakeng sa netefatso
pwa.auth.offline_message: Hokela hape ho tsoela pele ka ho kena.
pwa.auth.reset_subtitle: Kenya lengolo-tsoibila la hau mme re tla romella sehokelo sa ho seta bocha.
pwa.auth.reset_sent: Haeba ak'haonte e le teng, sehokelo sa reset se rometsoe.
pwa.auth.session_active: Nako ea hau ea sebetsa sesebelisoa sena.
pwa.auth.welcome_notification: Rea u amohela Mframapa. U ka qala ho sheba maemo a toropo.

advice.hazardous: E mong le e mong o lokela ho qoba mesebetsi eohle ea ka ntle.
